title: Lordress
description:
PRESENTATIONThis is an old-school 2D RPG in the style of the old Final Fantasy or the more recent Knightess and Maiden by Aldorlea Games.

STORY• A kingdom at war.

• A king turning into a tyrant.

• A noble house condemned for defiance.

Rhiannon was born into honor — and cast into chains.

Stripped of her name and everything she once knew, she must survive a land devoured by invasion, betrayal, and shifting loyalties. As barbarian hordes press against the realm and the crown tightens its grip through fear, one woman’s path will cut across battlefield, faith, and destiny.

In Lordress, you will live the rise of a warrior shaped by loss and hardened by war.

Forge alliances. Endure sacrifice. Command armies.

Decide what kind of ruler suffering creates.

Some are born to wear a crown. Others must take it.

FEATURES

• Experience 20 HOURS OF GAMEPLAY unfolding across a story that spans two decades of war, loss, and transformation

• Live through a complete and transformative life journey, guiding Rhiannon from youth to legend as war, loss, faith, and power shape the woman she becomes

• Explore a wide range of richly crafted locations — from haunted swamps and frozen mountains to ancient dungeons, secluded convents, and towering castles

• Discover and equip over 70 unique Runes — powerful artifacts that reshape your abilities and offer deep character customization

• Uncover hidden ultimate weapons, waiting for those who dare to seek them

• Find secret Runes concealed throughout the world
